payload.name: Extract-travel-location-period-facts
payload.description: When a message ties a person to a past travel or vacation location and a time period, extract a state/event candidate even if the location is mentioned in passing.
content: Create an event/state extraction candidate whenever a message associates a person with a location during a time period (e.g., a trip, vacation, visit, stay, or residence), even if that association is incidental to the message's main topic.
Resolve relative time references like 'last summer' or 'last year' to absolute dates using the message/session timestamp and record the resolved period.
When the location is a city with an unambiguous country, store both so country-level questions remain answerable.

solves: Extraction produced no candidate for a clear location-period fact ('vacation last summer in Bogota'), so it was never persisted. The missing rule is to emit state/event candidates from narrative travel/vacation mentions that tie a person, place, and time; resolve relative time to absolute dates; and include the unambiguous country. Applies to future messages containing person-location-time associations; not to hypothetical/future plans or time-less place mentions.
